name: Hauptgebäude (Main Building)
location: Central campus, look for the largest building
tips: All official paperwork (enrollment certificates, transcripts) is issued here. Bring your student ID.

name: Mensa (Cafeteria)
location: Follow signs to 'Mensa' from the main entrance
tips: Load money onto your student card at the machine near the entrance. Meal plans available.

name: Bibliothek (Library)
tips: Use your student card to borrow books. Quiet zones on the upper floor. You can book study rooms online.

name: IT-Gebäude (IT Building)
tips: Go here in your first week to activate your university email and set up VPN for remote library access.
